newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depo curve firms, bonds idle, ecu/drs soft.
newsitem.headline: Greek depo curve firms, bonds idle, ecu/drs soft.

text.p: Greek interbank depos and forex forwards opened higher on a liquidity squeeze linked to Wednesday's forex outflows but dealers said they expected rates to ease after the central bank's offer to inject cash via a repo tender.
"Depos and forwards opened higher with the rise more accentuated in short periods," said a senior dealer at a foreign bank. "The central bank's move was expected and will lead to easier rates later."
The dealer estimated the liquidity shortage at between 150 billion to 200 billion drachmas.
Bank of Greece offered to inject an unspecified amount of drachmas into the market via a quick repo on Friday. Payment date is July 18 and maturity date is July 23.
Bonds were idling, holding low Thursday prices in lacklustre early dealings.
"There are very few deals so far and prices are holding," said a bond dealer at another foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 156.95/00 from Thursday's 157.095 fix, the dollar at 281.36/46 drachmas from 282.140 and the ecu at 309.80/90 from 309.85 drachmas.
Ecu/drachmas opened at 309.90/95 but receded after the central bank checked dollar/drachma rates, dealers said.
"The trend is downwards and we might test 309.50 in the next few days," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "Mark/drachma is just following ecu/drachma with ecu/mark trapped in tight ranges."
